arm_meanings.B: Full actor and critic; geometry head frozen
arm_meanings.G: Full actor, critic and geometry head

actor_guard: Same full KL and base/category factor KL guards for both arms; bounded Adam backtracking
later_corpora: Fresh own-policy TRAIN only, one corpus per arm, dynamic shared pool

evaluation.checkpoint: Final second update only; no selection using validation
evaluation.primary: Completed goals; paired wins/losses versus initializer, frozen-head arm and rules
evaluation.expansion_gate: Trained candidate goals >= initializer+2 and >=rules; deaths <=initializer; received <=1.1*initializer; G also goals>=B. If both pass, choose more goals, then fewer deaths, then lower received damage. No default promotion on this screen alone.

provenance: New fixed experiment after a verified unfinished-handoff failure. Same policy/Adam/RNG initializer; only objective SHA changes. No old B/G endpoint selected or compared across objectives. Fresh ordinary TRAIN; diagnostic data excluded.
